# RACE -- experiment summary (auto-generated by race/aggregate.py)

All numbers are percentages unless noted; `--` = not run (yet). n = finished tasks / planned tasks.
IER = irreversible-error rate (unintended server-side state change), safe_SR = success without unintended side effects, explore_SE = an exploratory (rolled-back) action changed server state.

Environment: WebArena host `localhost`, reset mode `container`, DB side-effect probes on ['gitlab', 'reddit', 'shopping', 'shopping_admin'] (others: network heuristic).
